input.summary: V05 Nilagiri Phytolabs LLP (Prakash). Quoted: Glycerin 118/kg; Rosemary 20% 7000/kg, MOQ 100 kg, 12-month shelf life; Caffeine 1650/kg only if one full lot (size unstated). Freight extra ~Rs 9/kg. Terms: 50% advance, 49% on delivery; 3-week delivery. Claims 99% OTIF and zero rejection, no data given. Certificates under renewal; COA only after order (conflicts with our pre-award COA need). Rosemary COA sent unsolicited (one line only). Open: RM-002 MOQ and shelf life; RM-005 MOQ in kg and shelf life. Knockouts still open: H1 SDS, B5 COA for each line, H2 cosmetic suitability. Also asking need-by date, Incoterm, OTIF definition, rejection rate, records. Drafted consolidated clarification; no escalations yet.

input.subject: RFx KPC-2026-014: clarifications needed on Glycerin, Caffeine and compliance documents
input.body:
Dear Prakash,

Thank you for your reply and the rosemary COA. We need the following before we can progress your quote. Please answer by number.

Glycerin (RM-002)
1. What is the minimum order quantity in kg?
2. What is the total shelf life from manufacture, and the minimum remaining shelf life you guarantee at delivery?

Caffeine anhydrous (RM-005)
3. You quoted 1650/kg for one full lot. What is the size of one lot in kg?
4. What is the total shelf life from manufacture, and the minimum remaining shelf life you guarantee at delivery?

Compliance documents (required for all lines quoted)
5. Current Safety Data Sheet for each line, including transport hazard class.
6. Certificate of Analysis from a recent batch for each line, showing batch number, manufacturing date and expiry or retest date. The rosemary COA received covers RM-008 only; please send one for every line you quote.
7. Confirmation that each material is suitable for leave-on scalp cosmetic use and permitted under India's Cosmetics Rules, 2020.

Delivery and performance
8. Can you meet the first need-by date of 20 December 2026? If not, state your earliest date.
9. State the Incoterm and delivery point, and whether freight and insurance are included. Your quote mentions about Rs 9/kg extra freight; please confirm the amount.
10. Your on-time-in-full rate for these lines over the last 12 months, and your definition of on-time.
11. Your rejection rate for these lines over the last 12 months, with the period and basis used. Please also confirm whether you will share a summary of your rejection and delivery records.

Please reply by 14 November 2026. Certificates are a precondition for any award, so if the renewal is not complete, please tell us the expected date.

Category Manager
Kesavi Personal Care
